entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange providing current spot, futures, P2P, staking, wallet, and OTC-linked services under the Kanga Global brand.
entity.notes: The current first-party platform exposes active global trading services and routes EU visitors to a separate MiCA-facing surface. Current independent exchange data identifies Kanga Global as Costa Rica-registered and reports recently updated markets. Older first-party terms named a Belize operator, so HEI does not make a broader current legal-entity claim.
